title: Fit a logistic regression by gradient descent
brief: Build the gradient X^T(p - y), a descent loop that records the loss before each step, and an accuracy function, then watch the weights grow on a perfect split.
hints: The gradient is X.T @ (sigmoid(X @ w) - y) + ridge * w. No loop over examples is needed.
In fit_gradient_descent, append the loss first, then compute the gradient, then break if np.linalg.norm(g) < tol, then update w = w - lr * g. That order makes history[0] the loss at zero weights.
train_accuracy compares the labels (predict_proba(w, X) >= 0.5) with y, and takes the mean.
On a perfect split the unpenalised weights keep growing, so pass tol=0.0 and a fixed max_iter to watch it.
